preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 100 for s in strings)
preconditions.description: Each string s has a length between 1 and 100.
Each string s consists only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines is equal to the number of test cases t.

postconditions.expression: all(output_line in ['YES', 'NO'] for output_line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all((output_lines[i] == 'YES' if strings[i] == strings[i][:len(strings[i])//2] * 2 else output_lines[i] == 'NO') for i in range(int(t)))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is 'YES' if the string is square, otherwise 'NO'.
